verdict.rationale: Docs describe resolution-quality tracking, simulation-based validation of workflows, and human handoff when the AI can't resolve a ticket — implying genuine end-to-end resolution rather than deflection — but there are no concrete resolution-rate figures, case studies, or independent benchmarks showing what share of conversations are actually fully resolved. missing for 10: quantified resolution-rate metrics, customer case studies or third-party validation of real-world resolution percentages.
